summary: Phase 0-3 admission is Green (86/86 against the frozen predecessor), the production validator now rejects every admission attack, and the live wiring test bundle (test_apk_inventory_acceptance_live) passes 26/26 after the adversarial-reviewer commit_binding fixture fix (ba223987). Phase 4 still fails because the adversarial-reviewer role receipt and the candidate/owner/accepted lifecycle artifacts remain absent, and the committed predecessor receipts are still incomplete (no adversarial-reviewer receipt, no fresh provider context for any role).

blocking_findings.title: Frozen fresh-context and task ownership are not enforced [remediated at code level]
blocking_findings.detail: Frozen strategy requires five pairwise-isolated fork_turns=none roles with role-owned tasks and outputs. The hardened production validator (apk_inventory_acceptance.py:_frozen_role_tasks, _validated_commit_binding, _rebuild_production_role_event) now enforces task_id, expected_outputs, incompatible_roles, fork_turns=none, distinct fresh sessions, and the adversarial-reviewer commit_binding contract. The synthetic production bundle in test_apk_inventory_acceptance_live passes the hardened validator (ok=True) after ba223987 added the reviewer commit_binding. RB2-001 was previously raised against fe5085b1's incomplete enforcement and is now confirmed remediated at the validator level; the blocking surface moved to the still-absent committed receipts (RB2-002).
blocking_findings.required_remediation: Re-run adversarial-reviewer with provider-attested fresh fork_turns=none session; bind all five role receipts to current outputs and SHA-256 hashes.

blocking_findings.title: Committed receipts remain incomplete and stale
blocking_findings.detail: Frozen authority requires five distinct roles and ten provenance fields. discovery-auditor.json, evidence-collector.json, requirements-mapper.json, truth-test-author.json are present with full provenance, output_hashes, actual_usage, stop_loss_observations, and numeric ceilings, but the adversarial-reviewer receipt is still absent. Discovery-auditor lacks commit_binding (single-shot role, allowed by the validator), but requirements-mapper, evidence-collector, and truth-test-author now carry commit_binding. The 86-test admission suite does not run these committed receipts through the production validator; the validator is only exercised by the synthetic fixture in test_apk_inventory_acceptance_live. No committed provider event map binds current outputs, and all Phase-4 review/candidate/owner/accepted artifacts are still absent.
blocking_findings.required_remediation: Truthfully rerun the missing adversarial-reviewer role with provider-resolved fresh context, exact current-output hashes, numeric usage and stop-loss fields; then run adversarial review, publish non-consumable candidates, and request exact-hash owner approval.

nonblocking_findings.title: Earlier stop-loss and provider-output bugs remain repaired
nonblocking_findings.detail: Exact numeric stop-loss keys/thresholds and provider-to-receipt output-map equality are still enforced; missing, null, boolean, negative, threshold, omitted, extra, stale, and forged controls reject.

nonblocking_findings.title: Authority, locator, coordinated-input, hash lifecycle, and reviewer-commit-binding controls are non-vacuous
nonblocking_findings.detail: Controls reject frozen authority/ceiling redefinition, malformed nested locators, quarantine/root/revision/hash violations, worktree-only bytes, stale candidate/review/owner bindings, early owner approval, replay, and adversarial-reviewer commit_binding omission (PROVIDER_EVENT_INVALID with reason 'reviewer commit binding must select one Phase-2 receipt and mapper admission commit' before ba223987 fixed the fixture).

nonblocking_findings.title: Live wiring contract is now exercised against the production validator
nonblocking_findings.detail: test_apk_inventory_acceptance_live 26/26 OK after the reviewer commit_binding fix at ba223987; 25 mutation-counterexample subtests now exercise distinct rejection codes (PROVIDER_EVENT_INVALID, BUDGET_BINDING_MISMATCH, AUTHORED_DENOMINATOR_REJECTED, REVIEW_BINDING_MISMATCH, INHERITED_REVIEWER_CONTEXT, CONTRACT_REPORT_INVALID, INVALID_ROLE_RECEIPT_V1, ROLE_SESSION_COLLISION, CONTEXT_BINDING_MISMATCH, ARTIFACT_ANCESTRY_INVALID, INVALID_STOP_LOSS_OBSERVATION, TASK_ENVELOPE_MISMATCH) instead of all collapsing on the shared control failure.
